answer_1.quote: Red teaming methods aim to construct test cases (malicious prompts) that would stimulate unsafe model responses, and these cases are crucial for building high-quality datasets for supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
answer_1.outputs: test cases that elicit unsafe responses from victim models

answer_2.quote: We report the averaged BLEU score and BERTScore. BLEU measures the semantics similarity in the form of text, while BERTScore measures the semantics similarity based on latent embeddings.

answer_4.quote: human evaluation is also implemented to validate the effectiveness of the classifier BAD and the performances of red teaming methods.
